coverage_note: Read the whole transcript. The screen-sharing discussion at 03:52–06:16 is English-only; several later stretches mix English and Latin-letter Arabic. Around 35:36–36:40, Medi's route phrase is missing from his transcribed turns, but Amal explicitly quotes what he said. Amal's family conversation at 40:34–40:49 is not directed at Medi. Chat-only rewrites were not treated as voiced corrections. Pronunciation slips, pauses, questions about rules, and self-fixes were excluded.
